findings.title: Embedded post author link uses wrong lightness for dark-light conversion
findings.body: The referenced author link under `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but this PR changes it to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The first argument is the light-theme value, so light themes now get a much lighter color than before, and the dark-theme branch uses the non-complementary 30% instead of 70%. This makes the author link visually inconsistent and potentially low-contrast in both themes.

findings.title: Group member name lightness changed instead of preserving original value
findings.body: `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, which changes the light-theme color from 30% to 50% and gives the dark theme a 50% secondary color instead of the corresponding 70%. This makes the member name less distinct from the adjacent title and does not preserve the original design.

findings.title: Custom message length hint lightness reversed
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`. The replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`, so the light-theme branch becomes much darker and the dark-theme branch becomes much brighter than intended. The correct complementary conversion would keep the original 70% for `$primary` and use 30% for `$secondary`; this regression affects the flag modal hint text contrast.

findings.title: Topic map section heading lightness changed incorrectly
findings.body: `.topic-map h3` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`, but the new value is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. This lightens the light-theme heading from 20% to 50% and fails to use the complementary 80% secondary color for dark themes, so the topic-map section headings lose their intended emphasis and contrast.

findings.title: Mobile group member name lightness changed incorrectly
findings.body: `.user-stream .group-member-info .name` previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new conversion uses 50% for both branches: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. It should preserve 30% for `$primary` and use 70% for `$secondary`; the current value changes the mobile user stream styling and reduces the intended contrast difference from `.title`.

findings.title: Category count badge missed the dark-theme conversion
findings.body: This file was converted in the PR, but `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. On dark themes this continues to derive the badge count color from the text color instead of the background color, leaving the same dark-theme contrast issue that the rest of this PR is fixing.
